name: Silver Centurion

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Plasma: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

signatureAbility:
Improved Lock-on
Silver Centurion's personal Shock and Plasma Debuffs become Passives and their duration is increased by [5 - 25]%.
While Locked-On Block Proficiency is increased by +[250 - 3,375.07].

abilitySections.title: Silver Centurion Armor
content: Start the fight with one indefinite Armor Up Buff, increasing Armor rating by +[750]. If this Buff is removed for any reason it re-triggers after 10 seconds.
While the above Armor Up Buff is active, Silver Centurion becomes immune to Bleed and Shock Effects.

abilitySections.title: Lock-On
content: To ready Lock-On Silver Centurion must remain near his Opponent for 12 seconds. As an Attacker, moving away from the Opponent before readying the Lock will cause progress to be lost over time.
Once Lock-On is ready it can be activated by throwing any Special Attack and is paused while standing near the Opponent.
The active Lock-On lasts 2 second(s), but each full Bar of Power adds 1 second(s) to it's duration. This duration is doubled for Defenders.
Lock-On lasts 25% longer against Mutants and 25% shorter against Cosmics.
Plasma effects are paused while Locked-On.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Whenever Silver Centurion would strike with a Critical Hit he instead inflicts a Shock Debuff that lasts for 3 seconds. The Potency scales with Critical Damage Rating.

If Lock-On is not active, inflicting Shock into an Incinerated Opponent or vice-versa will fuse those two effects into a Plasma Debuff that has the properties of both. This Plasma lasts for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Finish a combo with a Light Attack - Heat Punch
content: While Lock-On is not active, inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [589.05] Energy damage over 12 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it is active. This hit is a projectile and does not make contact with the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Second Medium Hit - Plasma Blast
content: While Locked-On, deal a burst of [1,178.1] Energy Damage per stack of Plasma.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict a non-stacking Slow Debuff for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation if Lock-On is active, it is refreshed.
Inflict a Heal Block Debuff, preventing the Opponent from recovering Health for 10 seconds.
If the Opponent has an Active Regeneration effect the Heal Block is turned into a Passive and lasts for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation if Locked-On, all Plasma effects are refreshed.

While Locked-On if the Opponent has 5 stacks or more of Plasma the last hit deals a burst [3,927] Energy Damage for each stack of Plasma. If the Opponent is under 5 stacks of Plasma inflict 3 stacks of Plasma instead.
If Lock-On is not active, the last hit inflicts a Plasma Debuff dealing Energy Damage based on the last hit landed over 12 seconds. The potency of this effect increases with Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Activate Lock-On even if the conditions are not met.
Inflict a Slow Debuff for 28 seconds.
Inflict a Power Drain Debuff that removes 1 Bar of Power plus an additional 25% of a Power Bar for each stack of Plasma over 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Improved Lock-on
content: Silver Centurion's personal Shock and Plasma Debuffs become Passives and their duration is increased by [5 - 25]%.
While Locked-On Block Proficiency is increased by +[250 - 3,375.07].
